name: Sautéed Vegetable & Black Bean Tacos Boats with Tangy Tomato Guacamole
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Seed and medium dice the bell peppers.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Add beans, corn, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet, stirring to combine. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocadoes. Slice while still in the skin, then scoop out into a medium bowl; mash slightly with a fork.
Medium dice the tomatoes; place in the bowl with the avocado.
Juice limes into the bowl, add salt, and stir to combine.
Separate whole leaves from the head of romaine for taco shells.
To serve, arrange romaine leaves on plates and fill with seasoned beans and veggies. Top with guacamole and enjoy!
author: Mealime
